notes: Strip d: x 4940-6480 plus ~300 px overlap (4640-6780). Plate is turned (not north-up). Victory: printed 'VICTORY' (x~4850,y~2100) and 'BLVD.' (x~5150,y~3050) on the leg from Rockdale to Blair, so recorded as Victory Boulevard; the NE leg from Rockdale to the plate top carries no name on this plate but is the same 44' road (44' printed on it) and is recorded as Victory Boulevard too. Gaff Avenue is an L: SSE leg from the Blair/Victory node (GAFF printed near y 3500, AVE. near y 4150) and WSW leg to Beresford (GAFF ... AVE. near y 4450-4550). A wedge-shaped strip continues SE from the Blair/Victory node (8'5" sewer) and narrows into a ~30 ft strip labelled CITY OF CINCINNATI running SE to Billings Street at about (6090,4250); it carries a sewer and is not named as a street, so it is not picked. Billings Street exists in two pieces: railroad to Jonathan (25') and y 3157 to Gilbert (50'); it leans slightly east going south (x ~6000 at north end, ~6125 at Gilbert). The unnamed 'ST.' between Mathers Avenue and Beresford: house numbers continue Mathers Avenue's, so it may be part of Mathers (printed AVE. further SW), recorded as '?'. Junction of Mathers Avenue, Melbourne Street and that '?' street at about (4590,5225) lies ~350 px west of the strip and was not picked here. Two curved lines from the west converging on the railroad near (4960,2430) are Cleveland Avenue's curbs (70' printed), not a spur. Jonathan printed only 'JONATHAN' (no suffix on this plate); recorded as Jonathan Avenue. Railroad (CL&N / Deer Creek valley line) is not a street.
